name: na.trim
title: Trim leading and trailing missing observations

origin.description: Trim leading and trailing missing observations.
origin.usage:
na.trim(object, ...)
na.trim.default(object, sides = c("both", "left", "right"), is.na = c("any", "all"), maxgap = Inf, ...)

arguments.name: sides
arguments.text: "both", "left", or "right". A unique prefix is accepted.

arguments.name: is.na
arguments.text: "any" treats a row as missing when any column is missing. "all" requires every column. A vector ignores this.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: A leading or trailing gap longer than maxgap is kept.

origin.details: Removes missing observations from the ends. An interior NA is kept. For one series, "any" and "all" do the same thing.
origin.value: c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) returns 1, NA, 3. The interior NA is the original missing value.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.trim(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
